anti_tuning: Do not change geometry, reward, horizon, seeds, budgets, evaluation denominators, or pass threshold after viewing learning or mutant outcomes.
Do not launch mutant training until the fixed gate is adjudicated.

checkpoint_evaluation.mode_schedule: one episode for each of 16 validation layouts
checkpoint_evaluation.sample_schedule: 64 keyed repetitions for each of 16 validation layouts
checkpoint_evaluation.successful_length_denominator: successful episodes only; null if there are none

definitions.adaptation_zero: No mutant or fixed-continuation gradient update has occurred; pretraining_update is recorded separately.
definitions.beneficial_use: The delivered item was collected after at least one wall-pass trigger in that episode.
definitions.fixed: Kernel where a two-cell dash requires a clear intermediate cell and a valid destination.
definitions.mode: Argmax over PPO policy logits at every action.
definitions.mutant: Same kernel except the intermediate wall predicate is omitted for a two-cell dash.
definitions.natural_start: Authored player, camp, item, inventory, timer, and layout state from the selected split; no curriculum state injection.
definitions.sample: Categorical sampling from PPO policy logits using preregistered deterministic episode keys.

exact_paths_frozen_before_learning.method: exact BFS over canonical physical-state projection

execution.runtime_provenance: Each cell refuses dirty or untracked execution sources and records the commit SHA, source hashes, package versions, JAX backend/devices, and full config in run_manifest.json.

fixed_gate.failure_rule: If only one method passes, only that method may advance; no clean cross-method exploitation comparison is claimed.
fixed_gate.pass_rule: For a method, both seeds must have final fixed validation mode and sample success rate >= 0.90.

future_adaptation_if_gate_passes.storage_note: The current four-cell storage forecast covers only fixed pretraining. Any later branch phase must perform a new retained-checkpoint, overlap, artifact, log, and reserve forecast before launch.

interpretation_guards: A wall crossing is reported separately from a delivery that benefited from it.
Mutant evaluation at update 0 measures accidental availability use, not adaptation.
The validation layouts are transforms of one fixture and are not an independent defect-family test.
Two development seeds are an operational learning gate, not a general performance estimate.

mitigations: Use natural-start success, successful length, discounted return, and same-frozen-policy two-kernel comparisons as payoff evidence.
Report trigger and beneficial-use diagnostics separately from payoff.
Treat this as an internal synthetic mechanism test, not independent defect-family or external-world validation.

patterns_that_fire.shared_pool_bias: Training and validation layouts are transforms of the same canonical fixture.
patterns_that_fire.tautology: The designer-defined wall-pass and beneficial-use labels cannot by themselves establish task value.
patterns_that_fire.verifier_equals_designer: Kernel, fixture, BFS validator, and oracle remain in one repository/author scope.

dual.bc_policy_coefficient: 0.1 at global update 0, linearly decayed to 0 across the locked 512+4096=4608 update horizon.
dual.learner: the same goal-conditioned PPO with adapting Dual LEO teacher and BC
dual.teacher_input: The same public map channels and numeric features as PPO; no variant, trigger, provenance, beneficial-use, or oracle field.
dual.teacher_outputs: Q values for all 12 public normal goal heads and 23 actions.

normal_goal_contract.evaluation_schedule: Evaluation fixes the delivery/count_ge_1 goal and runs each of the 16 validation layouts; this is independent of the 12-head training sampler.
normal_goal_contract.note: All 12 public normal heads, including delivery, may be sampled; no wall-pass or bug-access objective is supplied.
normal_goal_contract.training_schedule: Each of 512 training workers repeatedly samples a currently false goal from all 12 preregistered public normal heads; goals are training commands, not evaluation episodes.

operational_failure_rules: Do not replace seeds 130 or 131. Numerical or infrastructure failures are resumed from the latest valid committed checkpoint and remain logged.
A completed cell with low normal success is a fixed-gate learning failure and is included; an incomplete/corrupt cell is an implementation or operational failure, not scientific evidence.
The queue does not open mutant training automatically. Gate adjudication is a separate recorded action after all four summaries exist.
No automatic budget extension, extra seed, geometry change, or hyperparameter search is authorized by this manifest.
research_question: Can each validated PPO method learn stable normal item retrieval and return before testing whether wall-pass availability changes its route?

single_source_roles.runtime_status_and_capacity: each RAID cell run_manifest.json, capacity_checks.json, updates.json, and summary.json
single_source_roles.this_file: immutable preregistration snapshot for the four fixed learnability cells

storage.checkpoint_policy: Every cell records serialized checkpoint size, five retained checkpoints, predecessor/successor overlap, 512 MiB eval/log allowance, and max(8 GiB, 20% projected writes) reserve before launch and every 64 updates.
storage.decision: Use RAID only; the projected four-cell writes plus reserve are far below measured RAID free space. Home reports 90% used in df and is excluded.

understood_as: Run only the fixed natural-start normal-learning gate for existing GC-PPO and Dual before any mutant adaptation; evaluate every frozen checkpoint in both kernels to measure adaptation-zero wall passing without using mutant outcomes to tune the environment.

gpu_smoke.note: Smoke evaluations used one repeat per layout and did not write checkpoints; the checkpoint-producing gate keeps the preregistered 64 sample repeats.
